convos.name: Hattie
lines: NPC: "I think the asking matters more than the answer, out here."
NPC: "All sorted. Some things just work out."
NPC: On the way, Hattie stops and actually teaches you something — how they read a slope for water, how their grandmother did it. (Knowledge, freely given. The Codex notes it.)
NPC: "Since Casey died... I keep expecting to see Casey at the fire. Stupid."
YOU: "About that favor — we never finished."
NPC: "It's handled. Really — it is. I appreciate you asking, though."
YOU: "About what's been happening — we never finished."
NPC: "Sleep's gone strange. I check the treeline every hour at odd hours now. Whatever gets me to morning."
NPC: "The fire feels smaller without Casey. The rest of us will have to be bigger."
NPC: "I check the treeline every hour for Casey, now. Feels right. Feels like the least I can do."
NPC: "Alright, love. Go do what you need to do."

convos.name: Ursula
lines: NPC: They nod, satisfied — like a piece just clicked into place.
YOU: "What's weighing on you right now?"
NPC: "Huh. Let me think about that." "Casey is gone and the world just... continues. That's the part I can't stand."
YOU: "About that favor — that was Casey's thread. We never finished."
NPC: "The fever's not breaking and I'm barely keeping food down. I need help — real help, not just water."
NPC: "I'm burning up and there's nothing left in me. Someone who knows sickness — please."
YOU: "About what's been happening — we never finished."
NPC: "I taste the water before the others drink. It doesn't bring anyone back. It just keeps my hands from shaking."
NPC: "Any regrets? The real kind, not the small stuff."
YOU: "I didn't say what I needed to say. To someone. Now I can't."
NPC: Quiet. "Yeah. I think everyone's carrying one of those."

convos.name: Mateo
lines: NPC: "Let me be straight — My take? We're not going to like the answer, whatever it is."
NPC: It's quiet at the trap line. Mateo doesn't say much. Sometimes that's the whole point.
YOU: "Is there something you need? Really."
NPC: "You'll never guess what I saw by the treeline."
YOU: "Is there something you need? Really."
NPC: "Okay, so — something happened this morning."
YOU: "Is there something you need? Really."
NPC: "Have you heard? No? Good, I get to tell you first."
NPC: "Right. That's what I figured — which is why I asked you, not them."
YOU: "Is there something you need? Really."
NPC: "I just said — did you miss it?"
NPC: "I just told you — what else is on your mind?"
NPC: "Okay — I need to move. But I'm glad we talked."

convos.name: Ruby
lines: YOU: "Teach me something from the wild."
NPC: "There's more, but that's for another fire."
NPC: It's quiet at the hollow. Ruby doesn't say much. Sometimes that's the whole point.
YOU: "Yes. I don't want to get into what. But yes."
NPC: No judgment in their face. "We're all doing math that doesn't add up. You're still here. That counts."
YOU: "How are you holding up — really?"
YOU: "About that question — we never finished."
NPC: "Huh. I wouldn't have guessed that about you."
NPC: A neutral quiet returns, the kind where words land normally.
NPC: "Right. Action time. You know where to find me."

notes: staged gut-rot outbreak on 5 adults at d16; downstream (ticks/tending/relief/convo) fully real
